text:
Maya: Hey all — thinking of doing a low-key 'supper club' Friday 6:30pm. Idea: rotate between small chef tasting places and casual spots; also a quieter corner with boardgames for those not into loud bars. Who's in? RSVP + any venue recs. @here
Sam: Love it. In. Prefer quieter spots.
Priya: Count me in! Any budget cap? :dollar: I'd rather $30-50.
Diego: In for games, maybe after? Can bring Codenames. :game_die: 
Ava: I'm out that day, on call. Maybe next one. :sad_panda: 
Ken: Sounds great — can we do a poll for preferences? I can set a Doodle or Slack poll.
Priya: Poll question: tasting vs casual vs rooftop? Also vegan options required. :seedling: 
Maya: Good call. Doing a quick slash poll: /poll "Which vibe?" "Tasting (sit down)" "Casual (shared plates)" "Quiet games night" — vote by EOD
calendar-bot: Event created: Supper Club — tentative — Fri 6:30pm. RSVP open.
Sam: If voting splits, maybe split groups 6:30 tasting + 8:30 games? Works for me.
Maya: Love that. Final plan if poll splits: two groups, cross-invite after. I'll book a small table at a place with private room options. Anyone allergic to shellfish? @Priya (or anyone) speak up.
Priya: No shellfish for me. Vegan friend coming too — can handle?
Diego: No allergies. I can bring extra card decks. :+1: 
Ava: Next time for me. Enjoy!
Maya: Ok I'll reply with venue and menu tomorrow. Thanks y'all :partyparrot:
